title: task.list — Request
description: Deterministically scan a project's task queue. Claimable tasks are returned first, then actively leased tasks. Within the claimable bucket, sort by created_at ascending and id ascending. Within the leased bucket, sort by claim_expires_at ascending, then created_at ascending, then id ascending. Cursor-based pagination preserves that total order.

project_id.description: Project whose queue should be scanned.

status.description: Optional status filter. When omitted, implementations SHOULD default to the queueable states they surface for claim/lease scanning.

claimable_only.description: When true, return only tasks whose claim lease is absent or expired. When false, leased tasks may also appear after claimable tasks using the same total order.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior task.list response. The cursor encodes the claimable-first ordering opaquely.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return in this page.
